content: Sameeli zayte birille ekkidi zayteza Sa7oole hu7en gussidaappe guye yeeri ekkides; hessafe guye, «Ba xinxxo bolla ne haarizaade gidana mala Xoossi nena dooribeennee?

Hach ne taappe shaaketta bishin Biniyaame dhassan diza Xelxaho geetettizason diza Eraheeli duufo achchan diza nam7u asatara ne gayttana; isttika, ‹Ne koyza hareti beettida; ha7i ne aaway haretas qoppizayssa aggidi ta naaza gishshas ta ay ooththiin kiyanee? gishe ceecen dees› gaana.

«Nenikka sinth gujja gujja baada Taabooren diza gita zaafezaso gakkanaas baana; heenkka heedzdzu asati issoy heedzdzu deysha laaqqa, nam7anththozi heedzdzu uketh, heedzdzanththozi woyne ushshi kumida lukkamo oykkidi Xoossaako Beetele kezishe nenara gayttana.
Istti nena sarokki simmidi nam7u uketh nees immana; nekka isttafe ekkana.

«Hessafe guye neni Filisxeeme olanchchati dizaso Xoossa zumaa Gibi7a kezana; ne katamayo gakkida mala nabeta duulatay, maasinqon, karaben, dinkeninne diiththan azhabettidi tinbite yootishe zumbullaan goynnizasoppe duge wodhdhishin ne istta demmana.
Ne qoppontta dishin GODAA Ayanay wolqqan kumidi ne bolla wodhdhana; nekka isttara tinbite haasaya doommana; neni hara as misata laamettana.
Hayti malatati ne bolla polettiza wode Xoossi nenara diza gishshas ne kushey ooththana dandayza ubbaa ooththa.

«Taappe sinththatada duge Gelgela wodhdha; tanikka xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarsho shiishshanaas neekko yaana; gido attiin ta neekko yaada ne ay ooththana bessizaakko ta yootanaashe gakkanaas laappun gallas ne takkana bessees» gides.
Sa7ooli Sameelappe shaaketti baana gishin Xoossi Sa7oole wozina laammides; malatati ubbay he gallas polettida.
Sa7ooli Gibi7a gakkishin nabeta duulatay iza demmides; Xoossa Ayanay wolqqan kumidi iza bolla wodhdhides; izikka isttara tinbite haasaydes.
Kase iza erizayti ubbay izi nabetara tinbite haasayshin be7idi istti bantta giddon, «Qiise naaza aazee bochchiday? Sa7ooli nabeta baggaa?» gishe issoy issaa oychchida.
He deren de7iza issi addezi, «Istta aawaych izi oonee?» gi oychchides; hessa gishshas, «Sa7oolikka nabeta baggafee?» giza tosse qaala gidides.
Sa7ooli tinbite haasayi giigidaappe guye goynnizasoho pude zumbullaa bolla kezides.
He wode Sa7ooles aawaa ishay Sa7oolenne iza ashkaraa, «Intte awan deetii?» gi oychchides; isttika, «Nuni hareta koyana bidos; gido attiin istti beettontta ixxiin Sameelakko bidos» gida.
Sa7oole aawaa ishazikka, «Hayyana Sameeli nees yootidayssa taas yootarkkii!» gides.
Sa7oolikka zaaridi izas, «Nuus hareti beettidayssa qonccisi yootides» gides; gido attiin izi kawotanayssa Sameeli izas yootoyssa ba aawaa ishazas yootibeenna.
Sameeli Isra7eele deraa GODAA sinth Mixiphpha xeygidi,
isttas, «GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, ‹Tani Isra7eele asaa Gibxeppe kessadis; Gibxen intte un7etti dizasoppe, hara kawoteththata kusheppe ta inttena ashshadis› gees.

Hach gidikko intte metoppenne waayeppe inttena ashshida intte Xoossaa kadhidi, ‹Hanenna nuus kawo kawoththa› gideta. Hessa gishshas intte qommon qommoninne intte zarkken zarkken GODAA sinth shiiqite» gides.
Hessafe guye Sameeli Isra7eele qommota ubbaa shiishshiin Biniyaame qommoy doorettides.
Kaallidikka Biniyaame qommota istta zarkken zarkken shiishshides; Maxire zarkkey doorettides; wurseththan Qiise naa Sa7ooli doorettides; gido attiin koyishin izi beettibeenna.
Asatikka, «Addezi yidee?» gi oychchida; GODAYKKA, «Ee, yides; gido attiin Sa7ooli miishshata giddon qotetti uttides» gides.
Isttika woxxi biidi izi qotetti dizasoppe ekki yida; izi deraa giddon eqqidaashe geesan izara likkettiza asi dontta gishshas asi ubbay izas hasheppe garsan attees.
Sameelikka kumeththa dereza, «GODAY dooridayssa beyeetii? Deraa ubbaa giddon izara giniza asi deenna» gides; derezi ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Kawoy mernaas kawoto!» gides.
Sameelikka kawos bessiza wogaanne maaraa deraas qonccisidaappe guye maxaafan xaafidi GODAA sinththan woththides; hessafe guye Sameeli asaa ubbaa baso baso baana mala yeddides.
Sa7oolikka baso Gibi7a bides; Xoossi istta wozina bochchida gita asati izara issife bida.
Issi issi shufuro asati, «Hayssa mala asi nuna ashshana dandayzee?» giidi iza kadhida; izas aykko imotakka ehibeettenna; Sa7ooli gidikko co7u gides.
